description: Head out to the Westside to witness backyard drag racing from local modified pickup trucks to full-on dragsters.

title: Upside Down Pilates
description:
Great Scott, Part 2
Lisa Orig and her team help people get in shape with exercises that strengthen and tone the entire body.

title: Hawaii Skin Diver
description: Journey to Christmas Island for a Red Sea Ocean Adventure trip-of-a-lifetime to target the Giant Trevally.

title: The Joy of Crafting
description: Joy creates a fun pop-up penguin card using Lawn Fawn dies; Rendall Madarang crafts another trendy project using Nano Tape; Joy shows how DIY felt character kits from Japan can be used for more than just keychains.

title: Ultimate Japan
description: The Hawaii folks put their hands to use as they hammer copper tumblers to create textured art, make gelato and try taiko drumming. They visit Toki no Mori Park to see the crested ibis and end with a memorable farewell dinner.

title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
description:
S04 E69 — Chef Lee Ann Wong
Chef Kevin Lee of PAI Honolulu joins Lanai in the kitchen and reveals the secret recipe of one of his delicious menu items, Chilled Poached Shrimp Salad.

title: Lanai's Travel Club
description: Lanai hits Bangkok, Thailand for bold bites, vibrant culture, fascinating people and sky-high rooftop bars with epic views.

title: Ninth Island Connection
description: Visit some eateries that are worth the trip off of the strip.
